simple.meaning: מִסְתּוֹר (miçtôwr) is a Hebrew word meaning “a refuge.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מִסְתּוֹר (H4563) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מִסְתּוֹר (miçtôwr) / H4563 is traced through Isaiah 4:6 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H4563. mistor מִסְתּוֺר noun [masculine] place of shelter ; absolute מִזֶּרֶם מִסְתּוֺר Isa 4:6 (figurative of ׳י s protection; compare סֵתֶר 32:2 ).

occurrences.englishText: There will be a pavilion for a shade in the daytime from the heat, and for a refuge and for a shelter from storm and from rain.
